annotations.title: Generate 13 CFR 125.6 (50% Rule) Teaming & Subcontracting Plan

description: Generate a legally compliant GovCon Teaming Strategy, a 13 CFR 125.6 & FAR 52.219-14 (Limitations on Subcontracting / 50% Rule) Prime/Sub workshare split, Ostensible Subcontractor risk audit, partner archetypes, FAR Subpart 9.6 Teaming Agreement clauses, and a BD outreach email. This is a read-only, stateless compliance and strategy generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `set_aside_type` enforces SBA workshare ceilings for 'sdvosb' [default], '8a', 'wosb_edwosb', 'hubzone', 'small_business', or 'full_and_open', while `bidder_role` tailors outputs for 'prime_seeking_subs' [default], 'sub_seeking_prime', or 'joint_venture_mentor_protege'). Use this tool when structuring Prime/Sub workshare splits or recruiting teaming partners to fill capability gaps; use `match_capability_statement` instead for an initial single-vendor Bid/No-Bid Pwin score.

bidder_capabilities.description: Bidder's socioeconomic status, self-performed technical domains, clearance level, and past performance strengths.

bidder_role.description: Bidder's teaming posture: 'prime_seeking_subs' (default, allocates >=50% to Prime and defines sub gap archetypes), 'sub_seeking_prime' (positions bidder for 20-49% specialty workshare), or 'joint_venture_mentor_protege' (13 CFR 125.8 JV compliance).

rfp_text.description: Raw RFP scope, PWS task areas, contract ceiling, security clearance requirements, and FAR 52.219-14 / set-aside instructions.

set_aside_type.description: Solicitation set-aside designation ('sdvosb' [default], '8a', 'wosb_edwosb', 'hubzone', 'small_business', or 'full_and_open') used to enforce 13 CFR 125.6 similarly situated entity and 50% self-performance rules.

name: generate_teaming_strategy

ostensible_subcontractor_risk.description: SBA 13 CFR 121.103(h)(3) affiliation risk assessment and mitigation steps.

partner_outreach_email.description: Tailored business development outreach email to recruit teaming partners.

recommended_partner_archetypes.description: Ideal subcontractor or prime partner profiles to close capability gaps.

teaming_agreement_clauses.description: Ready-to-paste FAR Subpart 9.6 Teaming Agreement exclusivity and workshare clauses.

workshare_allocation.description: Compliant Prime vs. Subcontractor percentage split under 13 CFR 125.6.

title: Generate 13 CFR 125.6 (50% Rule) Teaming & Subcontracting Plan
